Method of Attack: Spyware targeting Android mobile devices to spy on victims and steal data
Steals device information, contacts, SMS, call logs, account names and permissions, installed apps and permissions, clipboard data, GPS location, SIM info, files
Performs file actions such as deleting and stealing files
Records audio using device microphone to eavesdrop
Attack Vector: Distributed through fake Android app 'NumRent' (a virtual number generator)
Sideloaded via risky permissions requested by fake app
Promoted via dedicated website and URLs shared on Telegram and social media
